judgments.reason: The vignette explicitly states 'bilateral adrenal and periaortic retroperitoneal masses' were incidentally noted six months earlier, directly supporting the retroperitoneal masses component of the modifier.

The punch biopsy result explicitly describes 'a sparse perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells in the reticular dermis and subcutis,' which clinically supports skin involvement by lymphoma as part of the completed diagnosis label.
